Esperanto

[edit]

Etymology

[edit]

Borrowed from Italian tavolo. Doublet of tabelo, tablo, and tabulo.

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): /taˈvolo/
  • Audio:(file)
  • Rhymes: -olo
  • Syllabification: ta‧vo‧lo

Noun

[edit]

tavolo (accusative singular tavolon, plural tavoloj, accusative plural tavolojn)

  1. layer, stratum

Related terms

[edit]
  • tabelo
  • tablo
  • tabulo

Italian

[edit]

Etymology

[edit]

From Latin tabula, with a change in gender and inflection.

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): /ˈta.vo.lo/
  • Audio:(file)
  • Rhymes: -avolo
  • Hyphenation: tà‧vo‧lo

Noun

[edit]

tavolo m (plural tavoli, diminutive tavolino or tavolèllo, augmentative tavolóne)

  1. (furniture) table, board, desk
  2. (art) board, panel
    olio su tavolo ― oil on panel

Derived terms

[edit]
  • tavolino (“small table”)
  • tavolo da pranzo (“dining table”)
  • tavolone (“large table”)

Related terms

[edit]
  • tavola

Further reading

[edit]
  • tavolo in Collins Italian-English Dictionary
  • tavolo in Treccani.it – Vocabolario Treccani on line, Istituto dell'Enciclopedia Italiana

Anagrams

[edit]
  • Lovato, volato
